instruction: Remove Google Chrome from the dock favorites.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully removed vim from dock favorites by right-clicking the Vim icon and selecting 'Remove from Favorites'. Completed in 3 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can interact with GNOME dock, right-click context menus, select 'Remove from Favorites' option
metadata.task_rationale: Same removal pattern but targeting a different app (Chrome instead of Vim) to verify generalization
metadata.explanation: Task requires removing Google Chrome from dock favorites. Evaluator checks that favorites list contains only thunderbird and vim after removal. Reuses official check_gnome_favorite_apps metric.

scoring_breakdown.favorites_check: 1.0 - Favorites list matches expected after Chrome removal

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads GNOME dock favorites via gsettings get org.gnome.shell favorite-apps
Metric check_gnome_favorite_apps correctly parses the favorites string and compares against expected list using set equality and length check
Expected value ['thunderbird.desktop', 'vim.desktop'] is correct - matches the initial setup minus google-chrome.desktop
Metric parameter handling is correct: with expected.type='rule', the metric receives the rules dict directly and accesses rule['expected'] to get the expected apps list
Full coverage: the single instruction requirement (remove Chrome from favorites) is fully verified by checking the resulting favorites list
